lead.titleZh: 卒中患者跌倒风险：体育锻炼的系统综述和探戈对帕金森病运动改善的 RCT
lead.titleEn: Fall Risk in Stroke Patients: Exercise Systematic Review and Tango RCT for PD Motor Improvement
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共 9 条，覆盖 5 个专科。其中有 2 条神经康复相关研究得分最高（85 分），包括一项系统综述和一项 RCT，值得临床 PT 优先关注。这些研究分别为卒中患者跌倒预防提供了高证据等级的体育锻炼策略，并探索了适应性探戈对帕金森病运动功能的神经学机制。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's 9 entries span 5 specialties. Two neurorehabilitation studies, a systematic review and an RCT, scored highest (85 points) and warrant primary attention from clinicians. These provide high-level evidence on physical exercise strategies for fall prevention in stroke patients and explore the neurological mechanisms of adapted tango for motor function in Parkinson's disease.

items.title: Implementation of group-based health education and exercise for individuals with knee osteoarthritis in brazilian primary health care: a mixed-methods study.
items.summary: A mixed-methods implementation study of a physical therapist-led, group-based exercise and education program for knee osteoarthritis in Brazilian primary health care found high recruitment (87.3%), retention (83%), and adherence, with participants missing an average of 1.39 sessions. The program was feasible, well-accepted, and showed exploratory clinical improvements in pain and function.
items.curatedReason: 在低/中收入国家，将基于团体的膝骨关节炎运动和教育计划整合进初级保健是可行且广受欢迎的。这项研究展示了高招募率和依从性，提示该模式可有效提高此类地区的干预可及性。
items.titleZh: 巴西初级卫生保健中针对膝骨关节炎患者的团体健康教育和运动实施：一项混合方法研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在巴西初级卫生保健中进行的混合方法实施研究显示，由物理治疗师主导的团体运动和健康教育项目针对膝骨关节炎患者具有高度可行性和可接受性。该项目招募率达 87.3%，留存率 83%，依从性高，平均仅缺席 1.39 次，并初步显示疼痛和功能改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Integrating group-based exercise and education programs for knee osteoarthritis into primary care is feasible and well-received in low- and middle-income countries. This study demonstrates high recruitment and adherence, suggesting this model can effectively improve access to interventions in these regions.
items.limitation: 研究对象来自巴西，其结果在外推至其他文化和医疗系统时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study's findings, derived from a Brazilian context, should be interpreted with caution when generalizing to other cultural and healthcare systems.

items.title: Physical Exercise Reduces Fall-Related Outcomes Among People With Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 studies (1536 participants) found that physical exercise significantly reduced the number of falls by 39% (IRR = 0.61, 95% CI = [0.47, 0.78]) among people with stroke, with balance training and integrated cognitive components being most effective.
items.curatedReason: 物理锻炼能显著降低卒中患者的跌倒次数，尤其是平衡训练和结合认知成分的锻炼更有效。将这些发现整合到你的卒中康复方案中，特别是对慢性期和中度残疾的患者。
items.titleZh: 体育锻炼可减少卒中患者跌倒相关结局：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 18 项研究（1536 名参与者）的系统综述和 Meta 分析显示，体育锻炼显著减少卒中患者的跌倒次数达 39% (IRR = 0.61)，其中平衡训练和整合认知成分的锻炼效果最佳。
items.curatedReasonEn: Physical exercise significantly reduces the number of falls in stroke patients, with balance training and exercises integrating cognitive components being particularly effective. Integrate these findings into your stroke rehabilitation protocols, especially for patients in the chronic stage with mild to moderate disability.
items.limitation: Meta 分析未区分不同运动类型的具体干预细节和剂量，可能影响结果的泛化性。
items.limitationEn: The meta-analysis did not differentiate the specific intervention details and dosages of various exercise types, which might affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Leader and Follower Roles in Adapted Tango Reveal Complementary Neural Routes to Motor Improvement in Parkinson's Disease
items.summary: A 12-week randomized controlled trial found that adapted tango, in both Leader and Follower roles, significantly improved overall disease severity and motor impairment in people with mild-to-moderate Parkinson's disease, compared to a control group, suggesting complementary neural routes to motor improvement.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照研究提供了强证据，表明适应性探戈（无论是主导还是跟随角色）都能改善帕金森病患者的运动功能和整体疾病严重程度，且可能通过不同的神经通路起作用。在临床实践中，可以考虑将舞蹈治疗，特别是适应性探戈，作为帕金森病康复的有效辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 适应性探戈中的主导者和跟随者角色揭示了帕金森病运动改善的互补神经通路
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 12 周的随机对照试验发现，与对照组相比，轻中度帕金森病患者在适应性探戈中扮演主导者和跟随者角色均显著改善了整体疾病严重程度和运动障碍，这表明运动改善可能通过互补的神经通路实现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT provides strong evidence that adapted tango, in both leader and follower roles, can improve motor function and overall disease severity in Parkinson's disease, potentially through distinct neural pathways. Clinically, consider dance therapy, particularly adapted tango, as an effective adjunct in Parkinson's rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且仅限于轻中度帕金森病患者，结果在更广泛人群中的普适性有待进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small and limited to individuals with mild-to-moderate Parkinson's disease, so the generalizability of the findings to a broader population requires further validation.

items.title:
Associations between interpreter dependency and rehabilitation outcomes and care processes following acquired brain injury: a Swedish registry-based cohort study
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A Swedish registry-based cohort study of 13,900 inpatients with acquired brain injury found that interpreter dependency was associated with lower functional independence, health-related quality of life, and self-perceived health scores at admission and discharge, though not with the degree of improvement.
items.curatedReason: 语言障碍是脑损伤康复中被忽视的关键因素。该研究表明，口译依赖型患者在功能独立性、生活质量和自我感知健康方面表现更差，提示在制定康复计划时，除了临床因素，还应考虑患者的语言支持需求。
items.titleZh: 口译依赖与脑损伤康复结果及护理过程的关联：一项瑞典注册回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 13,900 名脑损伤住院患者进行的瑞典注册回顾性队列研究发现，口译依赖与入院及出院时较低的功能独立性、健康相关生活质量和自我感知健康评分相关，但与这些结果的改善程度无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Language barriers are a critical yet often overlooked factor in brain injury rehabilitation. This study indicates that interpreter-dependent patients experience poorer outcomes in functional independence, quality of life, and self-perceived health, suggesting that rehabilitation planning should integrate language support needs alongside clinical factors.
items.limitation: 这项回顾性队列研究可能存在未测量混杂因素（如脑损伤严重程度或早期护理差异）的影响。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study may be influenced by unmeasured confounders, such as injury severity or disparities in earlier care.

items.title: Association Between Therapeutic Education Delivered by a Community Post-Stroke Rehabilitation Team and Improvement in the Frenchay Activities Index: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (163 stroke survivors) found that home-based Therapeutic Patient Education (TPE) delivered by a Community Stroke Rehabilitation Team was associated with greater improvement in Frenchay Activities Index scores (mean change: 6.02 vs. 1.62, p < 0.001), particularly when combined with physical activity workshops.
items.curatedReason: 社区卒中康复团队提供的居家治疗性患者教育（TPE）与卒中后社会参与度提升相关，尤其在结合体育活动工作坊时效果更佳。这提示你在设计居家康复计划时，应积极考虑整合 TPE 和体育活动指导。
items.titleZh: 社区卒中康复团队提供的治疗性教育与 Frenchay 活动指数改善之间的关联：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（163 名卒中幸存者）发现，社区卒中康复团队提供的居家治疗性患者教育与 Frenchay 活动指数的显著改善相关（平均变化：6.02 vs. 1.62），尤其在结合体育活动工作坊时效果更佳。
items.curatedReasonEn: Home-based Therapeutic Patient Education (TPE) delivered by Community Stroke Rehabilitation Teams is associated with improved social participation post-stroke, especially when combined with physical activity workshops. This suggests you should actively consider integrating TPE and physical activity guidance when designing home rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 回顾性队列研究设计无法建立因果关系，且可能存在未测量混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: The retrospective cohort study design cannot establish causality and may be subject to unmeasured confounding factors.

items.title: Walking speed and propulsion asymmetry as distinct diagnostic biomarkers of gait impairment: Towards precision rehabilitation after stroke
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 57 individuals with chronic hemiparesis classified gait impairment by walking speed (<0.8 m/s) and propulsion asymmetry (>31.5%). It found that both speed and asymmetry were independent predictors of metabolic cost (R2=0.70, p < 0.001) and ambulatory function, reflecting distinct underlying biomechanical mechanisms (paretic propulsive power vs. distal-to-proximal power shift).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调，中风后偏瘫患者的步速和推进不对称是反映代谢成本和步行功能的独立指标。识别步速低于0.8米/秒和推进不对称超过31.5%的患者，能帮你更精准地进行患者分型，从而制定针对性的神经康复策略。
items.titleZh: 步速和推进不对称作为步态障碍的独立诊断生物标志物：迈向卒中后精准康复。
items.summaryZh: 一项对57名慢性偏瘫患者的横断面研究发现，步速和推进不对称是步态障碍的独立预测因子（例如代谢成本 R2=0.70, p < 0.001），并反映了不同的生物力学机制。慢步速与偏瘫侧推进力减弱相关，而高度不对称则表明从踝关节到髋关节的力生成发生远近端转移。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights that walking speed and propulsion asymmetry are independent indicators of metabolic cost and ambulatory function in chronic hemiparesis post-stroke. Identifying patients with walking speeds below 0.8 m/s and propulsion asymmetry exceeding 31.5% can help you more precisely phenotype patients to tailor neurorehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且需要前瞻性研究来验证这些生物标志物在指导康复干预中的预测价值。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality; prospective studies are needed to validate the predictive value of these biomarkers in guiding rehabilitation interventions.

items.title: Two-year follow-up of varus progression in young professional football players
items.summary: A two-year follow-up study of 31 adolescent male professional academy football players found that varus progression (increase in mechanical femorotibial axis angle, MAA) was most pronounced in younger athletes and significantly associated with greater increases in height, low initial height, BMI, and less initial varus deformity.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对青少年足球运动员的两年随访研究提示，股胫机械轴角度（MAA）的增加在年轻运动员中更为显著，且与身高和体重增长相关。在制定青少年足球运动员预防方案时，应特别关注生长发育期，早期识别并管理膝内翻风险。
items.titleZh: 青少年职业足球运动员膝内翻进展的两年随访研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 31 名青少年职业足球运动员的两年随访研究发现，膝内翻进展（股胫机械轴角度增加）在年龄较小的运动员中最为显著，并与身高、初始身高较低、BMI 和初始膝内翻畸形程度较轻的更大增幅显著相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This two-year follow-up study on young football players suggests that an increase in the mechanical femorotibial axis angle (MAA) is more pronounced in younger athletes and associated with growth in height and weight. When developing preventive strategies for youth football players, prioritize monitoring during growth spurts to identify and manage genu varum risk early.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本观察性队列，且入组球员均为在观察期内出现膝内翻进展的特定队列，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study is a small observational cohort of players specifically showing varus progression, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The effects of an enriched tennis program on the executive functions and motor skills of preschool children
items.summary: An 8-week enriched tennis program featuring open-skill activities significantly improved inhibitory control (p = .008, ηp2 = .184) and tennis-specific motor skills (forehand p = .001, ηp2 = .259; ball control p = .006, ηp2 = .200) in preschool children, compared to a control group with closed-skill activities.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 显示，为期 8 周的开放技能网球课程能有效改善学龄前儿童的抑制性控制和网球专项运动技能。这提示你在早期干预中，融入这类强调认知参与的动态开放技能活动，有助于提升儿童的运动与认知发展。
items.titleZh: 丰富网球课程对学龄前儿童执行功能和运动技能的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的丰富网球课程（包含开放技能活动）显著改善了学龄前儿童的抑制性控制（p = .008, ηp2 = .184）和网球专项运动技能（正手 p = .001, ηp2 = .259；控球 p = .006, ηp2 = .200），相较于仅进行封闭技能活动的对照组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT demonstrates that an 8-week open-skill tennis program can effectively improve inhibitory control and tennis-specific motor skills in preschool children. This suggests that incorporating dynamic, open-skill activities that emphasize cognitive engagement into early interventions can enhance children's motor and cognitive development.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且干预组和对照组在年龄上存在微小差异。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size, and there was a minor age difference between the intervention and control groups.

items.title: CMS Adds Medicare Options to Help People Manage Substance Use Disorder, Heart Failure, and Other Common Chronic Conditions
items.summary: CMS is expanding its Advancing Chronic Care with Effective, Scalable Solutions (ACCESS) Model to include technology-supported care options for Medicare beneficiaries with heart failure, COPD, substance use disorders, nicotine dependence, and expanded support for chronic musculoskeletal pain, starting in spring 2027. The model ties payments to measurable improvements in patient health.
items.curatedReason: 从 2027 年春季开始，美国 CMS 将通过 ACCESS 模型扩展对心力衰竭、COPD、物质使用障碍及慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛患者的 Medicare 远程护理选项。这意味着你在这些领域为 Medicare 患者提供基于技术的居家康复服务将有新的报销途径，密切关注实施细则，这会影响你未来的服务模式和收入。
items.titleZh: CMS 增加 Medicare 选项以帮助患者管理物质使用障碍、心力衰竭及其他常见慢性病
items.summaryZh: CMS 将通过其“推进慢性病有效可扩展解决方案（ACCESS）”模型，扩展对 Medicare 受益人的技术支持护理选项，涵盖心力衰竭、COPD、物质使用障碍、尼古丁依赖以及慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛的扩展支持，预计于 2027 年春季启动。该模型将支付与患者健康的可衡量改善挂钩。
items.curatedReasonEn: Starting in spring 2027, CMS will expand Medicare's technology-supported home care options for patients with heart failure, COPD, substance use disorder, and chronic musculoskeletal pain through the ACCESS Model. This implies new reimbursement avenues for you to provide technology-enabled home rehabilitation services to Medicare patients in these areas. Closely monitor implementation details, as this will impact your future service models and revenue.
